about_page.title: The story of LYNX Lining
about_page.subtitle: From selling the first Desmopan TPU linings to an own brand from Linz, Austria

milestones.title: Getting started in wear protection
milestones.text: Ing. Martin F. Heidecker starts business development and sales of Desmopan TPU wear linings, building years of application experience in mining, industry and plant engineering.

milestones.title: Production launch in Austria
milestones.text: In December 2019, the first production run of the Desmopan TPU material is successfully launched at AGRU – The Plastics Experts in Bad Hall, Upper Austria. Manufacturing “Made in Austria” becomes reality.

milestones.title: Founding of LYNX Lining
milestones.text: In early 2020, Martin Heidecker founds the trading company in Linz for international distribution of Desmopan TPU wear linings – with LYNX Lining as its own brand.

milestones.title: Wear protection for industry and mining
milestones.text: LYNX Lining supplies customers in Austria, Germany, Switzerland and the EU – from hopper linings and tipper bodies to railway applications. Consulting, sales and quality control remain in one hand.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about LYNX Lining TPU wear protection

items.q: What is LYNX Lining and what is it made of?
items.a: LYNX Lining is a wear protection film made of thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), manufactured in Austria. The material protects surfaces in mining, mechanical and plant engineering against extreme wear, corrosion and noise.

items.q: How much longer does LYNX Lining last compared to steel or rubber?
items.a: LYNX Lining achieves up to 30 times longer service life compared to steel, HDPE or rubber. In an independent master's thesis, LYNX Lining achieved the lowest abrasion value among 13 tested materials.

items.q: What applications is LYNX Lining suitable for?
items.a: LYNX Lining is suitable for bulk material conveyors, hoppers and feed bunkers in mining, truck tipper bodies and rail vehicles, recycling systems, as well as mechanical and plant engineering – wherever high material wear occurs.

There are two methods: adhesive bonding with contact adhesive on smooth substrates (steel, concrete, wood) and mechanical screw fastening for highly stressed areas. Installation is possible without special tools.
Yes, LYNX Lining consists of 100% recyclable thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) and is fully recyclable at the end of its service life.

items.q: Does LYNX Lining also reduce noise and vibrations?
items.a: Yes, LYNX Lining reduces noise emissions by up to 21 dB and effectively dampens vibrations. This extends the service life of production equipment and improves working conditions.

items.q: In what versions is LYNX Lining available?
items.a: LYNX Lining is available in 5 mm thickness as rolls or cut-to-size pieces. There are three versions: Standard (general wear protection), Comfort and Ultra (for extreme applications).
Yes, LYNX Lining delivers throughout Austria as well as to Germany, Switzerland and the entire EU.
